$Comment: Marn's daily: a fixed order of planks and bark, paid from one table.
Repeat.Reset with Period Daily is a CALENDAR daily, not a rolling wait: the allowance refreshes
at the day boundary on server time, so a player who finishes late in the evening can go again
the next morning rather than waiting a fixed number of hours from whenever they last claimed.
Author AtMinutes on the Reset block to move the boundary off midnight, or replace Period with
an Every block to set any other length.
It opens once First Cut is claimed, so every player who takes it owns a mill and knows how to
feed it. All three steps sit on Order 1, so they run together: a shift of twenty cycles at the
mill, and two deliveries that hand in to Marn only (TurnInNpcId 'giver'). The planks match any
species and any half-plank cut on CONTAINS, the bark is an exact id and a Sawmill byproduct,
so one day's milling covers all three. WORK_STATION counts only real cycles, which is what
keeps the shift honest: a stocked chest can fill the two deliveries, but the twenty are earned
at the block, and idle practice with nothing loaded does not tick. Its Target is the station
id as the station's own asset spells it, never the block's item id. Raise or lower any of the
three Amounts to change how long a day's order takes.
The whole payout is ONE Lootable reward, Lootables/Mmo_Sawmill_Order.json, which grows with the
player's Woodcutting level and luck and carries the daily's chance rolls; retune the odds
there, and nothing in this file needs to change to make the daily more or less generous. The
reward sits in the Claim bucket, so the roll happens when the player collects it.
Listing puts it in the misc category with the Repeatable tag, the same shelf as the temple's
own daily.
